ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I'm maintaining the original routing. My reasoning: the task is an open-ended content-creation job (building a full training presentation), which favors Petrel on two grounds. First, Petrel scores higher or equal on every relevant internal eval (Creative Generation 84.7 vs 82.7, Summarization 86.4 vs 80.6) and on all public benchmarks, so expected output quality is at least as good. Second, the task has high latitude and the user explicitly demands thoroughness; Plover self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, while Petrel has no such aversion. Note the preferences don't affect measured quality, but with capability essentially favoring Petrel anyway, there's no reason to route to the model that disprefers the task.
